title: Capture explicit setup attestation
description: Require an accessible operator action that attests exact setup and revision identities while listing every relevant condition the browser cannot inspect.
acceptanceCriteria: Attestation is unchecked by default and requires an explicit operator action
The disclosure names the selected setup, loading revision, configuration revision, and unobservable assumptions
The saved attestation records exact identities, disclosure version, action, and timestamp
Completing or cancelling restores focus and status is announced without relying on color

steps.details: Add a serializable SetupAttestation referencing exact setup/loading/configuration identities, disclosure version, acknowledged assumptions, action, and timestamp.
Create a semantic dialog or equivalent flow listing printer selection, media loading, print-dialog values, and other conditions the browser cannot inspect.
Keep confirmation false by default, persist only after affirmative action, and restore focus on confirm or cancel.
Add focused contract and Playwright keyboard tests for exact references, disclosure content, cancellation, focus restoration, and reload.

technicalNotes: Maximum execution scope is ten minutes; reuse the established modal, disclosure, and focus-management patterns.
Attestation records an operator statement; it is not automated verification or physical evidence.
Avoid coercive defaults and suitability language.
